QUOTE: By default the member is renamed to `private_nr`. Code that reaches into `ctx.nr` or `ctx->nr` then fails to compile, which tells the user the field is not part of the API.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the member name is renamed to `private_` so access by the original name fails to compile. That is compile-time enforcement through name-breaking. The fields stay visible in the header, which is consistent with the item.
